integrity: The universal parameter classification is proved by exact characteristic-root and coefficient-sign analysis. The bundled checker verifies symbolic identities and exact witnesses only; finite replay is not used as proof of the infinite all-step claim.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the scalar decay equation, a backward Euler starter, constant steps, and the classical third-order Adams–Moulton recurrence. It does not assert nonlinear SSP, arbitrary-start monotonicity, or system-level componentwise positivity.
title: Backward-Euler-started Adams–Moulton 3 has an isolated positivity point at its stability boundary
